description.text:
【工作簡介】
我們正在尋找一名【前端開發工程師 Front-End Engineer】，負責開發可擴展且具視覺吸引力的軟體介面與解決方案。您將是產品開發團隊中的關鍵成員，負責從構思到部署的前端軟體開發生命週期。
作為前端開發工程師，您應該熟悉前端開發語言、開發框架和第三方程式庫，與業務和應用程式開發團隊合作定義需求，設計架構並編寫文件，進行code review，解決複雜的開發和技術問題。
【工作職責】
-配合管理團隊與設計師，遵循任務的方向及滿足任務的需求，並找出可行的解決方案
-與公司內部各團隊合作，將核心技術轉化為易用介面
-與客戶合作，改進產品使用體驗
-設計並實現前端架構與介面
-使用可視化的用戶界面和有效的 API 構建前端應用程式
-確保 UI/UX 設計的技術可行性
-優化應用程式以實現良好效能和可擴展性
-測試軟體的品質與效率
-排除故障、調整和升級軟體
-撰寫技術文件
【具備條件】
-熟練掌握 JavaScript、TypeScript、HTML 和 CSS
-有使用 Angular 框架的經驗者優先考慮
-具備其他前端框架（如 React 或 Vue.js）經驗，並有意願學習和使用 Angular開發
-熟悉前端構建工具和開發流程 (例如：Angular CLI)
-了解網頁性能優化
-熟悉版本控制系統（例如：Git）
-良好的團隊合作能力和溝通技巧
【加分項目】
-具備大型專案中使用Angular之實務經驗
-熟悉前端工具鏈（如 Webpack、NPM）
-具備 UX/UI 設計原則的經驗
-了解測試框架（例如：Jasmine、Karma）
-了解敏捷開發方法論
-熟悉大型資料庫（例如：PostgreSQL、SQL Server、Oracle）和服務端技術
-擁有半導體製造領域的知識
【Job brief】
We are looking for a Front-End Developer to develop scalable and visually appealing software interfaces and solutions. You will be a key member of the product development team, responsible for the front-end software development lifecycle from conception to deployment.
As a Front-End Developer, you should be familiar with front-end development languages, frameworks, and third-party libraries. You will collaborate with the business and application development teams to define requirements, design architecture, write documentation, conduct code reviews, and resolve complex development and technical issues.
【Responsibilities】
-Collaborate with management team and designers to follow task directions and meet task requirements, and identify feasible solutions
-Collaborate with internal teams to transform core technologies into user-friendly interfaces.
-Work with customers to improve product user experience
-Design and implement front-end architecture
-Build front-end applications using visual user interfaces and effective APIs
-Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs
-Optimize applications for high performance and scalability
-Test software for quality and efficiency
-Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade software
-Write technical documentation
【Required Skills and Qualifications】
-Proficient in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS
-Experience with Angular framework is preferred
-Experience with other front-end frameworks (such as React or Vue.js) and a willingness to learn and use Angular
-Familiarity with front-end build tools and development processes (e.g., Angular CLI)
-Understanding of web performance optimization
-Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git)
-Good teamwork and communication skills
【Preferred Skills and Qualifications】
-Practical experience using Angular in large projects
-Familiarity with front-end toolchains (e.g., Webpack, NPM)
-Experience with UX/UI design principles
-Understanding of testing frameworks (e.g., Jasmine, Karma)
-Understanding of Agile development methodologies
-Familiarity with large databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle) and server-side technologies
-Knowledge of the semiconductor manufacturing industry
